lesson.title: The noisy hub
lesson.goal: Three PCs share one hub. Replace the hub with a switch so the collision counter stays at zero.

step.text: PC-A and PC-B talk through SharedHub. Open the hub's Config tab and look at the Collisions line.
A hub repeats every frame to every port; when two send together they collide. A switch gives each port its own collision domain.
Delete the hub, place a Switch 24, and cable all three PCs to it. Keep their addresses.
Ping PC-C from PC-A and check the switch has no hub left.

check.label: PC-A still reaches PC-C through the switch
